# Vendored GameNetworkingSockets build inputs

This directory contains the checked-in x86 static build inputs used by
`asrd_gns_wrapper.vcxproj`. It is the wrapper project's private third-party
boundary; the Source game DLL projects must use only the public wrapper API
and its import library.

## Contents

The directory is laid out for the three Win32 configurations in the wrapper
project:

```text
include/GameNetworkingSockets/   GameNetworkingSockets public headers
lib/debug/                       Debug static libraries
lib/release/                     Profile/Release static libraries
licenses/                        Dependency license texts
```

The static library sets contain `GameNetworkingSockets_s.lib`, protobuf,
Abseil, and utf8-range/utf8-validity libraries. Debug uses the debug protobuf
library (`libprotobufd.lib`); Profile and Release use `libprotobuf.lib`.
There are no third-party runtime DLLs in this directory. The wrapper's output
DLL and import library are generated by the project itself.

The following license files are included with the corresponding build inputs:

- `licenses/gamenetworkingsockets-copyright.txt`
- `licenses/abseil-copyright.txt`
- `licenses/protobuf-copyright.txt`
- `licenses/utf8-range-copyright.txt`

## Build provenance

The package corresponds to the upstream GameNetworkingSockets commit
`505c697d0abef5da2ff3be35aa4ea3687597c3e9` and was built through vcpkg using
the `x86-windows-static` triplet. Its relevant configuration is:

- `USE_CRYPTO=BCrypt`
- `USE_CRYPTO25519=BCrypt`
- `Protobuf_USE_STATIC_LIBS=ON`
- static MSVC CRT

The root-level `GNS_package/` directory is a relocatable package source for
rebuilding or updating these checked-in inputs. The Visual Studio solution
does not discover dependencies through vcpkg, `GNS_package/`, or an external
package path; the wrapper project references the `include` and `lib`
directories here explicitly.

## Link and runtime boundary

Only `asrd_gns_wrapper.vcxproj` includes the GameNetworkingSockets headers and
links the vendored static libraries. It also links the required Windows
system libraries, including BCrypt/CNG, Winsock, WinMM, IP Helper, and the
normal system libraries listed in the project file.

The client and server game DLLs must not include these headers or link these
static libraries directly. They consume the wrapper's small C API from
`src/public/asrd_gns_wrapper.h` and the generated import library
`src/lib/public/asrd_gns_wrapper.lib`. At runtime, only the wrapper DLL is
needed in addition to the operating system's Windows libraries; neither
`GameNetworkingSockets.dll` nor OpenSSL is deployed.

When redistributing or rebuilding this package, preserve the dependency
licenses above and the static-link configuration described here.
